t: A three-unit course on flying and coordinating Crazyflie micro-drone swarms.
steps: Find the course on the CS-STEM Network and read the unit list.
Ask IT to help with a Windows or Linux laptop.
Buy the Loco Swarm bundle and the Flow Decks.
Prepare open floor space and power supplies.
Complete Unit 1 with one drone first.
Read the CS2N privacy information before students sign in.
